scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.build:server: esbuild server/index.js --bundle --format=esm --platform=neutral --outfile=play/_service.js --banner:js="// Generated from server/ by npm run build. Edit those files, not this one."
scripts.watch: npm run build:server -- --watch & npm run build:client -- --watch
scripts.dev: npm run build && (npm run watch & yard dev)
scripts.check: npm run build && yard service check
